ब्राह्म्य m. (with मुहूर्त or °तक) dawn, the hour preceding sunrise, HYog.; Pañcar.
ब्राह्म्य n. (with or scil. हुत) worship or veneration paid to Brāhmans (considered as one of the 5 great sacraments = द्विजाग्र्यार्चा or मनुष्य-यज्ञ), Mn. iii, 73, 74
ब्राह्म्यतीर्थ: ब्राह्म्य—तीर्थ n. a partic. part of the hand (cf. under ब्राह्म), MārkP.
ब्राध्नायन्य: ब्राध्नायन्य m. patr. fr. ब्रध्न g. कुञ्जादि (f(°यनी). ; m. pl. °यनाः, Pāṇ. v, 3, 113 Sch.)
ब्रुव: ब्रुव b mf(आ)n. calling one's self by a name without any real title to it
being merely nominally (ifc.; cf. क्षत्रिय-, द्विज-, ब्राह्मण-ब्रुव).
ब्रू: ब्रू cl. 2. Ā. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 35) ब्र॑वीति, ब्रूते॑ (only pr. stem; the other forms are supplied by √ वच् cf. Pāṇ. ii, 4, 53; ब्रूमि for ब्रवीमि, R.; Subj. ब्र॑वस्, °वत्, RV.; Impv. ब्रूहि, ep. also ब्रवीहि, ब्रुवध्वम्; ब्रूतात्, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 35 Sch.; impf. अब्रुवम् for अब्रवम्, Up.; MBh.; pr.p. Ā. ep. ब्रुवमाण for ब्रुवाण; Prec. 2. pl. ब्रूयास्त, Nal. xvii, 36, prob. w.r. for ब्रूयास् तत्), to speak, say, tell (either intrans.; or with acc. of pers. or thing; or with acc. of thing and acc. dat. gen. or loc. of person = to tell or relate anything to; with two acc. also = declare or pronounce to be, call), RV. &c. &c.; to speak about any person or thing (acc. with or without प्रति, or अधिकृत्य), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to proclaim, predict, Var.; to answer (either intrans. with पुनर् or trans. with प्रश्नम्, ‘a question’), Mn.; MBh.;  (with अन्यथा) to speak or decide or judge wrongly, Mn.; Pañcat.;  (Ā., rarely P.) to call or profess one's self to be (nom., rarely with इति), RV.; Br.; MBh.;  (Ā.) to designate for one's self, choose, AitBr.;  (Ā.) to be told by itself, tell itself (tell its tale), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 89, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
ब्ली: ब्ली b (or व्ली; cf. √ व्री), cl. 9. P. (Dhātup. xxxi, 32) व्लीनाति, or व्लिनाति (pf. विव्लाय Gr.; aor. अव्लैषीत्, ib.; fut. व्लेता, ib.; व्लेष्यति, Br.; ind.p. -व्लीय, ib.), to press down, crush, cause to fall, Br. (Dhātup. also, ‘to choose, select’; ‘to go, move’; ‘to hold, maintain, support’) : Pass. व्लीयते, to sink down, collapse, succumb, PañcavBr.; MaitrUp. : Caus. व्लेपयति (aor. अविव्लिर्पत्), Pāṇ. vii, 3, 36; 86 : Desid. विव्लीषति Gr.: Intens. वेव्लीयते, to sink down, MaitrS.;  वेव्लयीति, वेव्लेति Gr.
ब्लेष्क: ब्लेष्क m. a snare, noose for catching, Kāṭh.
बठ्: बठ् (also written वठ्) cl. 1. P. बठति, to be big or fat, Dhātup. ix, 46; to be powerful or able, ib.
बण्: वण् (also written बण्) cl. 1. P. वणति (pf. ववाण &c.; Caus. aor. अवीवणत्, or अववाणत्), to sound, Dhātup. xiii, 3.
बभ्र्: वभ्र् (or बभ्र्), cl. 1. P. वभ्रति (aor. अवभ्रीत्, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 2 Sch.), to go, go astray, Dhātup. xv, 49.
बल्ह्: बल्ह् (also written वल्ह्; cf. √ बर्ह्) cl. 1. Ā. वल्हते to be excellent, Dhātup. xvi, 38; to speak; to kill; to hurt;  ‘to give’ or ‘to cover’ (दान v.l. छादन), ib. 40;  cl. 10. P. वल्हयति, ‘to speak’ or ‘to shine’ (भाषार्थे, or भासार्थे), Dhātup. xxxiii, 97.
बेह्: बेह् (also written वेह्) cl. 1. Ā. वेहते, to strive, make effort, Dhātup. xvi, 42;  cl. 1. P. वेहति = वेहाय, Vop.
